patthana14.37:1.1: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo ca na araṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.37:2.1: araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.37:3.1: saraṇañca araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.37:4.1: hetuyā pañca ārammaṇe dve avigate pañca.
patthana14.37:5.1: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.37:7.1: nahetuyā dve naārammaṇe tīṇi novigate tīṇi.
patthana14.37:8.1: sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi nissayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi paṭiccavārasadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
patthana14.37:9.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayenapaccayo: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa ca na araṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana14.37:10.1: araṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana14.37:11.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: …pe…
patthana14.37:12.1: hetuyā cattāri ārammaṇe cattāri adhipatiyā pañca anantare cattāri avigate pañca.
patthana14.37:13.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. sahajātapaccayena paccayo: .. upanissayapaccayena paccayo: .. pacchājātapaccayena paccayo: .. kammapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana14.37:14.1: saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. sahajātapaccayena paccayo: .. upanissayapaccayena paccayo: …pe…
patthana14.37:15.1: nahetuyā satta naārammaṇe satta naadhipatiyā satta naanantare satta novigate cattāri.
patthana14.37:18.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvāraṃ evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ. anulomapaccanīya dukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. anulomapaccanīya dukattikapaṭṭhānaṃ hetuduka kusalattikenahetuduka nakusalattikaṃ
